note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 5216 Section 5.3 (rfc/full/rfc5216.txt). TestEAPTLSMutualAuthHandshakeSucceeds and TestEAPTLSServerRejectsUntrustedClientChain only added ServerIdentity="eap-tls-server" (and serverConfig added AllowedIdentities=["eap-tls-client"]). Positive completes valid client path validation; negative still explicitly asserts *tls.CertificateVerificationError wrapping x509.UnknownAuthorityError over the peer's untrusted client leaf, which fires in crypto/tls before VerifyConnection/authorizeClient and is therefore completely unconfounded by identity authorization. Verdict stands: enforced.
